title: bash input
description: Run a shell command in the workspace and return its stdout, stderr and exit code. Commands run without a terminal and with a minimal environment. Output beyond about 56 KiB is dropped, not fatal. A command that runs past `timeout_ms` (default 2 minutes, at most 10) is stopped with its whole process group and what it printed so far is kept. Prefer the file tools to read, search and edit; use this for builds, tests and other programs. For anything long-running use `background: true` and read it with `job_output`.
